presentation.title: ORIGIN: Ethiopia's Living Coffee Legacy
presentation.description: From highland forest to ceremonial cup

textElements.content: Ethiopia, the living origin of the world's most beloved ritual.

textElements.content: Long before the first roast, before the first port shipment, a young herder named Kaldi noticed his goats dancing beneath an unfamiliar tree, restless from its bright red fruit.

textElements.content: “A restless flock. A red fruit. A world awakened.”

textElements.content: At the washing stations of Sidama and Yirgacheffe, water, wood, and patient hands begin the slow alchemy that turns ripe cherries into the parchment beans the world will one day taste.

textElements.content:
“Coffee is not only what we grow.
It is how we welcome the world.”

textElements.content: Before the city stirs, the coffee already moves.

textElements.content: Burlap sacks pass between hands marked by harvest. Chalk numbers ghost across wooden boards. Steam from morning tea threads through the lamp-lit aisles.

but the terroir remains.”
